---- MODULE W4Od16m8p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Instances == {"i1", "i2"}
Zones == {"z1", "z2"}
Bins == {"b1", "b2", "b3", "b4"}
NONE == "none"

ZoneOf == [b1 |-> "z1", b2 |-> "z1", b3 |-> "z2", b4 |-> "z2"]

VARIABLES zlock, block, pc, held

vars == <<zlock, block, pc, held>>

PC == {"idle", "coarse", "fine"}

Init ==
    /\ zlock = [z \in Zones |-> NONE]
    /\ block = [b \in Bins |-> NONE]
    /\ pc = [i \in Instances |-> "idle"]
    /\ held = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]

AcquireCoarse(i, z) ==
    /\ pc[i] = "idle"
    /\ zlock[z] = NONE
    /\ zlock' = [zlock EXCEPT ![z] = i]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = "coarse"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<block, held>>

AcquireFine(i, b) ==
    /\ pc[i] = "coarse"
    /\ zlock[ZoneOf[b]] = i
    /\ block[b] = NONE
    /\ block' = [block EXCEPT ![b] = i]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![i] = b]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = "fine"]
    /\ UNCHANGED zlock

AbortCoarse(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = "coarse"
    /\ zlock' = [z \in Zones |-> IF zlock[z] = i THEN NONE ELSE zlock[z]]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<block, held>>

Release(i) ==
    /\ pc[i] = "fine"
    /\ block' = [block EXCEPT ![held[i]] = NONE]
    /\ zlock' = [z \in Zones |-> IF zlock[z] = i THEN NONE ELSE zlock[z]]
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, z \in Zones : AcquireCoarse(i, z)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, b \in Bins : AcquireFine(i, b)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : AbortCoarse(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Release(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ zlock \in [Zones -> Instances \cup {NONE}]
    /\ block \in [Bins -> Instances \cup {NONE}]
    /\ pc \in [Instances -> PC]
    /\ held \in [Instances -> Bins \cup {NONE}]

MutexBins ==
    /\ \A i \in Instances : pc[i] = "fine" => (held[i] # NONE /\ block[held[i]] = i)
    /\ \A i, j \in Instances :
        (i # j /\ held[i] # NONE /\ held[j] # NONE) => held[i] # held[j]

cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutexBins
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser controls access to a shared pool of drug
cabinets using hierarchical locking: a dispenser first takes a coarse lock on a
storage zone, then a fine lock on a specific bin inside that zone before it may
dispense from the bin. Two independent dispenser instances run against the same
physical pool of zones and bins, so their lock requests interleave. An instance
acquires a zone only if the zone is free, then acquires a bin in a zone it holds
only if the bin is free, and finally releases both the bin and its zone when the
dispense completes. An instance that has taken a zone but not yet a bin may also
abort early, releasing the coarse zone lock without ever dispensing.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two dispenser instances ever hold the same bin at the same time, and a dispensing instance always owns the fine lock on the bin it is drawing from.

---- MODULE W4Od6m4p0t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

Cars == {"c1", "c2"}
Caps == {1, 2, 3}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES st, bay, queue, cap

vars == <<st, bay, queue, cap>>

Range(s) == {s[k] : k \in DOMAIN s}

Init ==
    /\ st = [c \in Cars |-> "idle"]
    /\ bay = NONE
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ cap = 2

Request(c) ==
    /\ st[c] = "idle"
    /\ Len(queue) < cap
    /\ c \notin Range(queue)
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, c)
    /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![c] = "waiting"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<bay, cap>>

Grant(c) ==
    /\ bay = NONE
    /\ queue # <<>>
    /\ Head(queue) = c
    /\ bay' = c
    /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![c] = "serving"]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED cap

Finish(c) ==
    /\ bay = c
    /\ bay' = NONE
    /\ st' = [st EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, cap>>

Resize(k) ==
    /\ k \in Caps
    /\ k >= Len(queue)
    /\ cap' = k
    /\ UNCHANGED <<st, bay, queue>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Request(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Grant(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Finish(c)
    \/ \E k \in Caps : Resize(k)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ st \in [Cars -> {"idle", "waiting", "serving"}]
    /\ bay \in Cars \cup {NONE}
    /\ queue \in Seq(Cars)
    /\ cap \in Caps

MutexHoistway ==
    /\ \A c \in Cars : (st[c] = "serving") <=> (bay = c)
    /\ \A a, b \in Cars : (st[a] = "serving" /\ st[b] = "serving") => a = b

====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutexHoistway
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper funnels dispatch requests through a single
express hoistway, the critical resource that only one elevator car may occupy at
a time. Pending cars queue in a bounded dispatch buffer; when the buffer is full
the controller applies backpressure and refuses further requests until space
frees up. The buffer capacity is tuned at runtime by building management, but the
controller only shrinks it to a value no smaller than the number of cars already
waiting. A car requests service (joining the queue if there is room), the
controller grants the head of the queue exclusive use of the hoistway, and the
serving car finishes and vacates the hoistway.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one car ever occupies the express hoistway, and the car recorded as serving is exactly the car occupying the hoistway.

---- MODULE W4Od5m8p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Players == {"p1", "p2", "p3"}
Lobbies == {"l1", "l2"}
Regions == {"r1"}
RegionOf == [l1 |-> "r1", l2 |-> "r1"]
CAP == 2
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES inbox, rlock, llock, members

vars == <<inbox, rlock, llock, members>>

Init ==
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ rlock = [g \in Regions |-> NONE]
    /\ llock = [l \in Lobbies |-> NONE]
    /\ members = [l \in Lobbies |-> {}]

Seated(p) == \E l \in Lobbies : p \in members[l]

SendReq(p, l) ==
    /\ ~ Seated(p)
    /\ ~ \E m \in inbox : m.p = p
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[p |-> p, l |-> l]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rlock, llock, members>>

AcquireRegion(p, l) ==
    /\ [p |-> p, l |-> l] \in inbox
    /\ rlock[RegionOf[l]] = NONE
    /\ rlock' = [rlock EXCEPT ![RegionOf[l]] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, llock, members>>

AcquireLobby(p, l) ==
    /\ [p |-> p, l |-> l] \in inbox
    /\ rlock[RegionOf[l]] = p
    /\ llock[l] = NONE
    /\ llock' = [llock EXCEPT ![l] = p]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, rlock, members>>

Commit(p, l) ==
    /\ [p |-> p, l |-> l] \in inbox
    /\ rlock[RegionOf[l]] = p
    /\ llock[l] = p
    /\ Cardinality(members[l]) < CAP
    /\ ~ Seated(p)
    /\ members' = [members EXCEPT ![l] = members[l] \cup {p}]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {[p |-> p, l |-> l]}
    /\ rlock' = [rlock EXCEPT ![RegionOf[l]] = NONE]
    /\ llock' = [llock EXCEPT ![l] = NONE]

Leave(p, l) ==
    /\ p \in members[l]
    /\ members' = [members EXCEPT ![l] = members[l] \ {p}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, rlock, llock>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players, l \in Lobbies : SendReq(p, l)
    \/ \E p \in Players, l \in Lobbies : AcquireRegion(p, l)
    \/ \E p \in Players, l \in Lobbies : AcquireLobby(p, l)
    \/ \E p \in Players, l \in Lobbies : Commit(p, l)
    \/ \E p \in Players, l \in Lobbies : Leave(p, l)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ inbox \subseteq [p : Players, l : Lobbies]
    /\ rlock \in [Regions -> Players \cup {NONE}]
    /\ llock \in [Lobbies -> Players \cup {NONE}]
    /\ members \in [Lobbies -> SUBSET Players]

BoundedCapacity ==
    \A l \in Lobbies : Cardinality(members[l]) <= CAP

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BoundedCapacity
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker seats players into lobbies that each have a
hard seat capacity that must never be exceeded. All lobbies live in one shared
region, and to seat a player the matchmaker uses hierarchical locking: it first
takes the coarse region lock, then the fine per-lobby lock, and only then commits
the seating. Join requests arrive over an unordered network and accumulate in a
request pool, so they may be processed in any order. A player sends a join
request for a lobby, a worker acquires the region lock, then acquires the target
lobby lock, and finally commits the seating (adding the player, consuming the
request, and releasing both locks) provided the lobby still has a free seat. A
seated player may also leave a lobby at any time, freeing a seat.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No lobby ever holds more players than its seat capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od11m1p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2", "s3"}
NONE == "none"
Nxt == [n1 |-> "n2", n2 |-> "n1"]

VARIABLES token, alloc, owns, pending

vars == <<token, alloc, owns, pending>>

Init ==
    /\ token = "n1"
    /\ alloc = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ owns = [n \in Nodes |-> {}]
    /\ pending = {}

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Nxt[token]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alloc, owns, pending>>

Request(n, s) ==
    /\ alloc[s] = NONE
    /\ [n |-> n, s |-> s] \notin pending
    /\ pending' = pending \cup {[n |-> n, s |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, alloc, owns>>

Claim(n, s) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ [n |-> n, s |-> s] \in pending
    /\ alloc[s] = NONE
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = n]
    /\ owns' = [owns EXCEPT ![n] = owns[n] \cup {s}]
    /\ pending' = pending \ {[n |-> n, s |-> s]}
    /\ UNCHANGED token

Release(n, s) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ s \in owns[n]
    /\ alloc' = [alloc EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ owns' = [owns EXCEPT ![n] = owns[n] \ {s}]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pending>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Slots : Request(n, s)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Slots : Claim(n, s)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, s \in Slots : Release(n, s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Nodes
    /\ alloc \in [Slots -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ owns \in [Nodes -> SUBSET Slots]
    /\ pending \subseteq [n : Nodes, s : Slots]

NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A n \in Nodes, s \in Slots : (s \in owns[n]) <=> (alloc[s] = n)

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A print shop runs two independent spooler instances that draw from one shared
pool of output slots. To serialize access the spoolers form a token ring: a
single token circulates between the two instances, and only the instance
currently holding the token may claim or release a slot. Each instance also keeps
its own private ledger of the slots it believes it owns. An instance first
records a request to claim a slot, and when it holds the token it claims a free
slot (marking the global allocation table and its private ledger together), or it
releases a slot it owns, or it simply passes the token onward.
SAFETY PROPERTY: An instance's private ledger of owned slots agrees exactly with the global allocation table, so no slot is ever double-allocated to two instances.

---- MODULE W4Od8m0p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Students == {"a", "b", "c"}
CAP == 2
NONE == 0

VARIABLES free, enrolled, ver, snap

vars == <<free, enrolled, ver, snap>>

Init ==
    /\ free = CAP
    /\ enrolled = {}
    /\ ver = 1
    /\ snap = [s \in Students |-> NONE]

ReadSnap(s) ==
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![s] = ver]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, enrolled, ver>>

Commit(s) ==
    /\ snap[s] = ver
    /\ ver < 8
    /\ s \notin enrolled
    /\ free > 0
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled \cup {s}
    /\ free' = free - 1
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]

Retry(s) ==
    /\ snap[s] # NONE
    /\ snap[s] # ver
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![s] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<free, enrolled, ver>>

Drop(s) ==
    /\ s \in enrolled
    /\ ver < 8
    /\ enrolled' = enrolled \ {s}
    /\ free' = free + 1
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Students : ReadSnap(s)
    \/ \E s \in Students : Commit(s)
    \/ \E s \in Students : Retry(s)
    \/ \E s \in Students : Drop(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ free \in 0..CAP
    /\ enrolled \subseteq Students
    /\ ver \in 1..64
    /\ snap \in [Students -> (1..64) \cup {NONE}]

Conservation ==
    Cardinality(enrolled) + free = CAP

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
A university course-registration system manages a fixed number of seats in a
course. Students register using optimistic locking with retry: a student first
reads a snapshot of the current version stamp, then attempts to commit an
enrollment. The commit succeeds only if the version stamp has not changed since
the snapshot was taken and a seat is still free; each successful commit bumps the
version stamp. If the version has moved on, the student's snapshot is stale and
the attempt is retried by discarding the snapshot and reading again -- a student
may be slow to retry but is never considered failed. A student already enrolled
may also drop the course, returning the seat. Seats are neither created nor
destroyed: every seat is either free or occupied by exactly one enrolled student.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of enrolled students plus the number of free seats always equals the fixed course capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od11m0p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Writers == {"w1", "w2", "w3"}
MAXV == 8

VARIABLES rec, ver, applied, snap, reading

vars == <<rec, ver, applied, snap, reading>>

Init ==
    /\ rec = {}
    /\ ver = 1
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ snap = [w \in Writers |-> [content |-> {}, v |-> 1]]
    /\ reading = {}

Read(w) ==
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![w] = [content |-> rec, v |-> ver]]
    /\ reading' = reading \cup {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, ver, applied>>

CommitAdd(w) ==
    /\ w \in reading
    /\ snap[w].v = ver
    /\ w \notin applied
    /\ ver < MAXV
    /\ rec' = snap[w].content \cup {w}
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {w}
    /\ reading' = reading \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

CommitRemove(w) ==
    /\ w \in reading
    /\ snap[w].v = ver
    /\ w \in applied
    /\ ver < MAXV
    /\ rec' = snap[w].content \ {w}
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ applied' = applied \ {w}
    /\ reading' = reading \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Retry(w) ==
    /\ w \in reading
    /\ snap[w].v # ver
    /\ reading' = reading \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rec, ver, applied, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Writers : Read(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : CommitAdd(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : CommitRemove(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : Retry(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Snaps == [content : SUBSET Writers, v : 1..MAXV]

TypeOK ==
    /\ rec \subseteq Writers
    /\ ver \in 1..MAXV
    /\ applied \subseteq Writers
    /\ snap \in [Writers -> Snaps]
    /\ reading \subseteq Writers

NoLostUpdate ==
    rec = applied

cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A print shop keeps one shared configuration record that two independent spooler
instances both edit, drawing on the same pool of writer identities. To avoid lost
updates the record uses optimistic locking with retry: a writer reads a snapshot
of the record's contents together with its version stamp, then attempts to commit
a change. A commit is accepted only if the version stamp still matches the
snapshot, in which case the writer folds its own contribution into the record and
bumps the version; if the version has advanced the snapshot is stale and the
attempt is retried by discarding it and reading afresh. A writer that has
previously committed may likewise commit a removal of its contribution under the
same version check. The record must always reflect exactly the set of writers
whose commits currently stand -- no committed update is ever silently lost.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The shared record's contents equal exactly the set of writers currently marked as having a standing committed contribution.

---- MODULE W4Od3m7p4t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Banks == {"b1", "b2", "b3"}
CAP == 2

VARIABLES reg, batch, status, snap, reading

vars == <<reg, batch, status, snap, reading>>

Live == {b \in Banks : status[b] = "live"}

Init ==
    /\ reg = 0
    /\ batch = {}
    /\ status = [b \in Banks |-> "live"]
    /\ snap = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
    /\ reading = {}

ReadReg(b) ==
    /\ status[b] = "live"
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![b] = reg]
    /\ reading' = reading \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, batch, status>>

CASAdd(b) ==
    /\ status[b] = "live"
    /\ b \in reading
    /\ snap[b] = reg
    /\ reg < CAP
    /\ b \notin batch
    /\ reg' = reg + 1
    /\ batch' = batch \cup {b}
    /\ reading' = reading \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, snap>>

CASRetry(b) ==
    /\ b \in reading
    /\ snap[b] # reg
    /\ reading' = reading \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, batch, status, snap>>

Crash(b) ==
    /\ status[b] = "live"
    /\ Cardinality(Live) >= 2
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![b] = "crashed"]
    /\ reading' = reading \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, batch, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks : ReadReg(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : CASAdd(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : CASRetry(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Crash(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg \in 0..CAP
    /\ batch \subseteq Banks
    /\ status \in [Banks -> {"live", "crashed"}]
    /\ snap \in [Banks -> 0..CAP]
    /\ reading \subseteq Banks

BoundedBatch ==
    /\ reg = Cardinality(batch)
    /\ Cardinality(batch) <= CAP

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BoundedBatch
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch collects at most a fixed number of
settlements before it is closed. Member banks add settlements by racing on a
single compare-and-swap register that counts the entries admitted so far. A bank
reads the current register value, then attempts a compare-and-swap: if the
register still holds the value it read and the batch is below capacity, the swap
installs the incremented count and folds the bank's settlement into the batch;
otherwise the read was stale and the bank retries by re-reading. A member bank may
also crash silently at any time and stop participating, though the batch keeps at
least one live member so progress is always possible.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The compare-and-swap register always equals the number of settlements in the batch, and that count never exceeds the batch capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od5m6p6t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Players == {"p1", "p2"}
NONE == "none"
MAXE == 6

VARIABLES epoch, holder, cached, log

vars == <<epoch, holder, cached, log>>

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 1
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ cached = [p \in Players |-> 0]
    /\ log = [actor |-> NONE, ep |-> 0]

Grant(p) ==
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ epoch < MAXE
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ holder' = p
    /\ cached' = [cached EXCEPT ![p] = epoch + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED log

Act(p) ==
    /\ holder = p
    /\ cached[p] = epoch
    /\ log' = [actor |-> p, ep |-> epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holder, cached>>

Revoke ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ epoch < MAXE
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cached, log>>

AdminOverride ==
    /\ log' = [actor |-> "admin", ep |-> epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, holder, cached>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Grant(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Act(p)
    \/ Revoke
    \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 1..MAXE
    /\ holder \in Players \cup {NONE}
    /\ cached \in [Players -> 0..MAXE]
    /\ log \in [actor : Players \cup {NONE, "admin"}, ep : 0..MAXE]

NoStaleAuthorized ==
    \A p \in Players : (cached[p] = epoch) => (holder = p)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleAuthorized
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby grants host privileges to one player at a time using a
lease keyed by a monotonically increasing epoch number. Granting the lease to a
player bumps the epoch and stamps that fresh epoch into the player's cached view;
revoking the lease also bumps the epoch, which instantly makes the former host's
cached epoch stale. The current host may take a host action only while its cached
epoch still matches the live epoch, so a stale ex-host can never act. A privileged
admin override may act at any moment regardless of the lease. The four operations
are: grant the lease to a player, the host performs an authorized action, revoke
the lease, and the admin override acts.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The only player whose cached epoch equals the current live epoch is the current lease holder, so no stale ex-host is ever still treated as authorized.

---- MODULE W4Od13m2p0t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Machines == {"m1", "m2"}
Controllers == {"c1", "c2"}
NONE == "none"
Votes == {"yes", "no"}

VARIABLES phase, votes, owner, proposer

vars == <<phase, votes, owner, proposer>>

Init ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ votes = [c \in Controllers |-> NONE]
    /\ owner = NONE
    /\ proposer = NONE

Propose(m) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ owner = NONE
    /\ phase' = "voting"
    /\ proposer' = m
    /\ votes' = [c \in Controllers |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

Vote(c, v) ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ votes[c] = NONE
    /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![c] = v]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, owner, proposer>>

Commit ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \A c \in Controllers : votes[c] = "yes"
    /\ owner' = proposer
    /\ phase' = "held"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, proposer>>

Abort ==
    /\ phase = "voting"
    /\ \E c \in Controllers : votes[c] = "no"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ proposer' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, owner>>

Release ==
    /\ phase = "held"
    /\ owner' = NONE
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ proposer' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED votes

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Propose(m)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, v \in Votes : Vote(c, v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ Release

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting", "held"}
    /\ votes \in [Controllers -> Votes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ owner \in Machines \cup {NONE}
    /\ proposer \in Machines \cup {NONE}

MutexVault ==
    /\ (owner # NONE) <=> (phase = "held")
    /\ (phase = "voting") => (owner = NONE)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutexVault
nl:
A vending machine network shares one physical coin vault that only a single
machine's transaction may hold at a time. To decide who gets exclusive access the
network runs two-phase commit: a requesting machine proposes taking the vault,
every controller casts a yes/no vote, and only a unanimous yes lets the
coordinator commit and hand the machine exclusive ownership. Controllers may be
slow to vote but never fail, so votes are cast one at a time in any order and the

    /\ held = [w \in Handlers |-> NONE]

    /\ zlock' = [zlock EXCEPT ![z] = w]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![w] = "coarse"]

    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w] = c]
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![w] = "fine"]

    /\ pc[w] = "coarse"

    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![w] = NONE]

cap at runtime but never below the number of chutes already in use. A handler
acquires a free zone, then acquires a free chute in a zone it holds provided the

just the zone. The operations are: acquire a coarse zone lock, acquire a fine chute
lock if capacity allows, abort a coarse lock early, release both locks, and resize
the concurrency cap.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No two handlers ever hold the same chute at once, and a working handler always owns the fine lock on the chute it is servicing.
